scores.tell: Calculator floats tilted with mild perspective and flat pattern backdrop; matches the real towel/planet cards. Small tell: keys are slightly wide-angle.

Wide landscape scene with a full ground plane, far crater rim and a starry sky, so it has many depth layers. Real cards are closer and simpler. The crater at the lower right is strongly foreshortened.
Roll sits on grass in front of a radial sunburst, with a low camera and a simple two-layer depth. It fits the real cards. Only the grass tufts at the front are a slight extra foreground layer.
Hilltop scene with trees, clouds and a distant hill, built as a miniature diorama. The tower and house have inconsistent perspective, and the depth is deeper than a real card.
Backpack seen from a mild three-quarter view with a little top face and a simple floor and backdrop. It reads as one consistent view, like the real cards. None that matter.
Lifeguard chair is shot from below with strong converging legs and a foreshortened canopy. The wide-angle look is stronger than on real cards, and the cloud layers are busy.
Spotlight and truss hang in a clean gradient with a mild angle and one clear depth layer. Close to the real floating-object cards. The truss perspective is slightly strong.
Tilted object floating over a flat patterned backdrop, with the same camera as the real towel and planet cards. None.
Real wagon card: mild three-quarter view, a ground plane with a soft background and no strong perspective.
Floating asteroid with flames over a flat pattern is a good fit. The craters give a slightly stronger sense of a sphere than the real cards, and the camera is flat.
